summary: The audit checks the 28 units: LINGUIST 1, core courses from two of three areas, and LINGUIST 150 or 160 (or a course in the history of a language the Director of Undergraduate Studies approves), each taken for 3 or more units and a letter grade of C- or better. The rest are electives you choose with the Director of Undergraduate Studies in advance and move in by hand. No more than two courses may be CR/NC; a third counts for nothing. Checked by hand: at least 3 units for every course, and that the courses go beyond what your major needs. External credit is not accepted.
